notes: CabalCoin (src/CabalCoin.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 named Cabal Coin with symbol CABAL and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 CABAL (10^27 minor units, the INITIAL_SUPPLY constant) once to msg.sender, which is the factory during the launch. There are no owner, roles, mint, burn, pause, blacklist, tax, reflection, upgrade or rescue functions; supply cannot change after construction and ordinary transfers deliver exactly the requested amount, so the factory, distributor and pool manager flows need no exemptions. The launch deploys no application contracts. The pool pairs CABAL with IMD at the launch policy's 1.25% fee; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
